stories.title: Greenfield Valley café creates 12 jobs in first six months
stories.summary: A thriving new café has created 12 local jobs and welcomed visitors from across North Wales and beyond after a successful first six months at Greenfield Valley. stories.title: Higher Kinnerton by-election: Flintshire People’s Voice candidate Josh Swash takes 566 of 620 votes cast
stories.summary: Flintshire People’s Voice candidate Josh Swash has won the Higher Kinnerton by-election with 566 votes, 545 more than his nearest rivals. stories.title: National park covering parts of Flintshire set to be dropped by Welsh Government
stories.summary: Plans for a new national park that would take in parts of Flintshire look set to be dropped after a Welsh Government minister said he was minded to reject them. stories.title: Former charity shop in Mold’s Daniel Owen Precinct is becoming a health hub, opening November
stories.summary: A new health centre with consultation rooms for rent to NHS and private practitioners is set to open in Mold’s Daniel Owen Precinct. Hughes Pharmacy is behind the Health and Wellbeing Hub at Unit 4a, which has received capital funding through the Welsh Government’s Transforming Towns programme.
